description: Series colour mode conformance cases. Each case is a widgets[].options object run through the Zod widget schema (ui colors-conformance.test.ts), the Go validateDashboard path and the embedded dashboard JSON Schema (internal/insights/series_conformance_test.go). All three must agree with valid on every case. modes lists the seriesColorMode vocabulary. A document without seriesColorMode behaves as name. statusLabels and percentileLabels are the well-known labels the UI maps to roles when no rule matches; Go and the JSON Schema do not colour series, so they only check the mode.
